To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
near wall common intima-media thickness provides at least as strong associations with atherosclerosis and cardiovascular risk as the average of near wall and far wall measurements.

the near wall common caroid intima-media thickness is as strong a predictor as the far wall common caroid thickness for cardiovascular disease, in particular for cardiovascular disease in the lower extremities.

near wall intima media thickness is a good indicator of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, and that the association with cardiovascular disease and peripheral arterial disease is stronger compared to far wall intima media measurements.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method for the detection of atherosclerotic disease in the carotid arteries, based on ultrasound.
the question of which wall (near vs. far) of the common carotid artery should be measured in epidemiological and clinical studies.
the question whether near wall carotid intimal thickness measurements can replace far wall measurements.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the near wall measurement is the preferred measurement of the carotid intimal-media thickness, because the near wall measurement provides at least an equal or stronger association with the cardiovascular disease and lower limb atherosclerosis as the far wall measurement.

the average of near wall and far wall common caratid intima-media measurements is a better indicator of cardiovascular risk than far wall intima measurements only, but that the near wall measurements alone are at least as good as the combined near wall and far measurements.

the near wall intima media thickness measurement is at least as good as the far wall measurement, and possibly better, for the prediction of cardiovascular disease and lower limb arterial atherosclerosis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

in a large cohort of elderly people, near wall common carotic intima media thickness measurement provides at best as good an indicator for atherosclerosis elsewhere as does the far wall intimal medial thickness measurement.
near wall intima-medial thickness is as good as far wall intima-medical thickness in predicting cardiovascular disease.

, in general, it seems reasonable to perform the common carotid artery intima-media thickness assessment on both the far wall and the near wall, because the near wall intima media thickness measurements seem to provide at least as good information on atherosclerotic disease elsewhere as the far wall measurements.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the near wall intima media thickness measurements can be used as a substitute for the far wall intimation media thickness measurements in epidemiological studies.

near wall intima media thickness measurements can be used in place of far wall measurements, and that the use of average intima-media thickness values is not superior to near wall intima medial thickness values in assessing cardiovascular risk.
near wall intima media thickness measurement may be a good alternative to far wall intima media measurement.
